title: [LLK] Dest->Src bank waits still miss the math-pipeline drain at 33 sites (WH + BH)
body:
## Summary

[PR #52256](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-metal/pull/52256) fixed the generic Blackhole destination-reuse handshake by adding a math-pipeline drain to the wait that gates `MOVD2A` / `MOVD2B`:

```cpp
// before
TTI_STALLWAIT(p_stall::STALL_MATH, p_stall::SRCA_VLD);
// after
TTI_STALLWAIT(p_stall::STALL_MATH, p_stall::MATH | p_stall::SRCA_VLD);
```

That fix was applied to exactly two functions in one file. The same bare wait is still present at **33 other sites across 16 files**, on both Wormhole and Blackhole, including the canonical `transpose_dest` LLK and several TTNN-private LLK copies compiled by production kernels.

This issue tracks the remaining sites. It deliberately excludes every site already covered by an open or merged PR (see *Out of scope* below), so it does not overlap [#53655](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-metal/issues/53655) / [PR #53690](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-metal/pull/53690) or [PR #54731](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-metal/pull/54731).

## Mechanism

`p_stall::SRCA_VLD` / `SRCB_VLD` are [`STALLWAIT`](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-isa-documentation/blob/main/WormholeB0/TensixTile/TensixCoprocessor/STALLWAIT.md) conditions **C10** / **C11**:

> **C10** — keep waiting if `SrcA[MatrixUnit.SrcABank].AllowedClient != SrcClient::MatrixUnit`
> **C11** — keep waiting if `SrcB[MatrixUnit.SrcBBank].AllowedClient != SrcClient::MatrixUnit`

Both index `MatrixUnit.SrcABank` / `SrcBBank` live, at the Wait Gate. Those bank pointers are advanced in the *epilogue* of the preceding Matrix Unit instruction — the `if (FlipSrcA)` / `if (FlipSrcB)` block at the very end of [`ELWMUL`'s functional model](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-isa-documentation/blob/main/WormholeB0/TensixTile/TensixCoprocessor/ELWMUL.md#functional-model), and equivalently for `SETRWC` with a `CLR_*` operand.

So with a bank-flipping Matrix Unit instruction still in flight, C10/C11 test the *pre-flip* bank — which the Matrix Unit still owns — are satisfied vacuously, and the wait is forgotten. By the time the following `MOVD2A` / `MOVD2B` executes, the flip has landed, and it writes the *post-flip* bank: one the unpacker still owns and may be filling.

`MOVD2A` and `MOVD2B` do not auto-wait for this. Both ISA pages say so explicitly and direct software to use `STALLWAIT` with exactly these condition codes ([`MOVD2A`](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-isa-documentation/blob/main/WormholeB0/TensixTile/TensixCoprocessor/MOVD2A.md#instruction-scheduling), [`MOVD2B`](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-isa-documentation/blob/main/WormholeB0/TensixTile/TensixCoprocessor/MOVD2B.md#instruction-scheduling)). The ISA's own note on C10/C11 — *"rarely needed, as Matrix Unit (FPU) instructions which read from SrcA or SrcB automatically wait for this condition"* — is precisely why these Dest→Src **writes** are the exception that needs the explicit wait, and why the symptom is a silent value mismatch rather than a hang.

Adding `p_stall::MATH` selects condition **C7**:

> **C7** — keep waiting if the current thread has an instruction in any stage of the Matrix Unit (FPU) pipeline

which drains the pipe so C10/C11 observe the post-flip pointer. C7's documented requirement is that the block mask include **B6** (block new Matrix Unit instructions); every site here already passes `p_stall::STALL_MATH`, which *is* B6, so that precondition is already satisfied.

`STALLWAIT` stays latched while *any* selected condition says keep-waiting and is forgotten only once *all* are simultaneously met, so a single combined mask is correct and no extra instruction is needed. That matters for the sites recorded into the replay buffer (`generalized_moe_gate_eltwise_binary`, the `deepseek_moe_gate` variants), where the recorded instruction count must not change — it does not.

**Cost.** C7 is a real drain, and the ISA notes it "might wait longer than strictly necessary" when the Matrix Unit is shared across threads. This trades a small amount of math-pipeline overlap for correctness, which is the same trade #52256 already made on the two generic Blackhole paths.

`STALLWAIT` holds until all selected conditions are simultaneously true, so a single combined mask is correct and sufficient; no extra instruction is added. This matters for the sites recorded into the replay buffer (`generalized_moe_gate_eltwise_binary`, the `deepseek_moe_gate` variants) where the recorded instruction count must not change — it does not.

## Affected sites

`p_stall::SRC?_VLD` → `p_stall::MATH | p_stall::SRC?_VLD`, preserving any existing `WAIT_SFPU`.

**Canonical LLK — Wormhole**
| File | Sites |
|---|---|
| `tt_llk_wormhole_b0/common/inc/cmath_common.h` | `move_d2a_row_broadcast_fixed_face`, `wait_bank_valid<SrcA>`, `wait_bank_valid<SrcB>` |
| `tt_llk_wormhole_b0/llk_lib/llk_math_transpose_dest.h` | `_llk_math_transpose_dest_` |
| `tt_llk_wormhole_b0/llk_lib/experimental/llk_math_generalized_moe_gate_eltwise_binary.h` | RELOAD replay sequence |
| `tt_llk_wormhole_b0/llk_lib/experimental/llk_math_generalized_moe_gate_transpose_dest_single_face.h` | `copy4rows`, `step1_hi`, `step0`, `step1`, `step2` |

**Canonical LLK — Blackhole**
| File | Sites |
|---|---|
| `tt_llk_blackhole/common/inc/cmath_common.h` | `move_d2a_row_broadcast_fixed_face`, `wait_bank_valid<SrcA>`, `wait_bank_valid<SrcB>` |
| `tt_llk_blackhole/llk_lib/llk_math_transpose_dest.h` | `_llk_math_transpose_dest_` |
| `tt_llk_blackhole/llk_lib/experimental/llk_math_generalized_moe_gate_transpose_dest_single_face.h` | `copy4rows`, `step1_hi`, `step0`, `step1`, `step2` |
| `tt_llk_blackhole/llk_lib/experimental/llk_math_face_compressed_mm.h` | split-partial merge |
| `tt_llk_blackhole/llk_lib/experimental/llk_math_rmsnorm_bcast_scalar_dest_reuse.h` | `rmsnorm_bcast_scalar_reuse_dest_as_src` |
| `tt_llk_blackhole/llk_lib/experimental/llk_math_sdpa_bcast_col_srcb_reuse.h` | preamble |
| `tt_llk_blackhole/llk_lib/experimental/llk_math_sdpa_bcast_col_srca_srcb_reuse.h` | preamble |
| `tt_llk_blackhole/llk_lib/experimental/llk_math_sdpa_custom_mm_reuse_dest_srcb.h` | main loop |
| `tt_llk_blackhole/llk_lib/experimental/llk_math_custom_mm_reuse_dest_srcb.h` | main loop |

**TTNN-private LLK copies** under `ttnn/cpp/ttnn/operations/experimental/deepseek/moe/deepseek_moe_gate/device/kernel_includes/tt_llk/`
| File | Sites |
|---|---|
| `tt_llk_wormhole_b0/llk_lib/llk_math_deepseek_moe_gate_eltwise_binary.h` | `DEST_TO_SRCA`, `DEST_TO_SRCB` |
| `tt_llk_wormhole_b0/llk_lib/llk_math_deepseek_moe_gate_transpose_dest_single_face.h` | `step0`, `step1`, `step2` |
| `tt_llk_blackhole/llk_lib/llk_math_deepseek_moe_gate_transpose_dest_single_face.h` | `step0`, `step1`, `step2` |

These private copies are compiled by the TTNN DeepSeek MoE gate operation, so fixing only the canonical headers would leave the production path defective — the same trap called out in #53655. PR #53690 covers the Blackhole `deepseek_moe_gate_eltwise_binary` copy; the Wormhole copy and both `transpose_dest_single_face` copies are not covered by any PR.

Two of the sites (`move_d2a_row_broadcast_fixed_face`, `wait_bank_valid<>`) currently have no callers in the repository. They are included because they are pre-broken templates: the defect ships the moment something calls them.

## Out of scope

Excluded because another PR already owns them:

- `tt_llk_wormhole_b0/common/inc/cmath_common.h` `move_d2a_fixed_face` / `move_d2b_fixed_face` — open PR #54731
- `tt_llk_blackhole/.../llk_math_deepseek_moe_gate_eltwise_binary.h`, `tt_llk_blackhole/.../llk_math_generalized_moe_gate_eltwise_binary.h`, and the TTNN-private Blackhole `deepseek_moe_gate_eltwise_binary` copy — open PR #53690 (issue #53655)
- `tt_llk_blackhole/common/inc/cmath_common.h` `move_d2a_fixed_face` / `move_d2b_fixed_face` — already fixed by merged PR #52256

Excluded because they are a different hazard, not this one:

- `llk_math_compressed_custom_mm.h` — the wait gates a `SETRWC` and a matmul replay, not a Dest→Src move
- `llk_math_sdpa_custom_mm.h` — the wait gates `MOVB2D`, which *reads* SrcB rather than writing it
- `ckernel_sfpu_topk_xl.h` — `STALL_CFG` waits around SFPU configuration
- All of Quasar — `move_d2a_fixed_face` / `move_d2b_fixed_face` / `llk_math_transpose_dest.h` / `llk_math_reduce.h` / `llk_math_unary_broadcast.h` carry the same bare waits, but Quasar's `STALLWAIT` has a different operand encoding and its bank handshake has not been assessed here. This needs a Quasar owner and a separate issue.

## Verification

The wait is a mask constant, so the change is behaviour-preserving except for the added drain, and it cannot alter recorded replay lengths.

The defect class is latent by nature — it produces a wrong value only when a bank flip is in flight at the wait, which no current test forces — so this is an inspection-and-ISA-grounded fix in the same mould as #53655/#53690, not a fail-without/pass-with reproduction. Blackhole regression coverage is available on this box and will be run. **The Wormhole sites cannot be executed here and need a Wormhole board before merge.**

## Follow-up

The TTNN-private LLK copies mean a fix to a canonical header silently misses production callers. @jasondavies raised the same point on #53655. Consolidating those copies onto the canonical implementation would prevent the next instance of this and is worth a separate issue.
